upgrade.a-upgrade-tab.png:
Mobile portrait game UI mockup, 440x900 aspect (portrait phone), for a dark rune-tech tower defense game "Rune Nexus". This is the "permanent upgrade" (영구 강화) tab of the lobby. Reference image 1 is the CURRENT in-game upgrade tab; reference image 2 is the CURRENT research tab. Problem: both tabs use the same navy-metal 2-column cards with cyan accents, so they feel identical. Goal: redesign ONLY the upgrade tab body so it has its own identity as a FORGE / TRAINING HALL (instant, repeatable leveling with runes, levels go up to 30-100), clearly different from research (which stays navy blueprint cards with cyan frames and timers).
Keep EXACTLY from reference 1: the dark stone-hall background, the top header (small icon + "영구 강화" on the left, resource frame top-right showing diamond 300 and rune 640), the bottom 5-tab nav bar (스테이지, 코어, 강화 selected, 연구, 포탑) and the small combat/economy segmented toggle (crossed red swords selected, bronze scales) above the nav. Same game-quality painted metal UI rendering, crisp, readable Korean text, no web/SaaS look, no glow overload.
Content (combat category, exact Korean text): 
1. 넥서스 체력 — Lv.12/30 — "모든 런의 넥서스 최대 체력이 영구적으로 증가합니다." — 현재 +12 → 다음 +13 — level-up button cost rune 232
2. 기초 화력 훈련 — Lv.37/100 — "모든 런에서 모든 포탑의 피해량이 증가합니다." — +55.5% → +57.0% — cost 700 (NOT affordable: button dimmed)
3. 물리 화력 훈련 — Lv.8/50 — "물리 포탑의 피해량이 증가합니다." — +16.0% → +18.0% — cost 177
4. 원소 화력 훈련 — Lv.5/50 — "원소 포탑의 피해량이 증가합니다." — +10.0% → +12.0% — cost 119
5. 치명 충격 — Lv.14/50 — "모든 포탑의 치명타 추가 피해율이 증가합니다." — +14%p → +15%p — cost 228
Each item keeps its existing square icon from reference 1, the level-up action ("레벨업" with rune cost chip) placed next to its item, and the next value highlighted in warm gold.
VARIANT A — "Forge rows": single-column list of horizontal rows (one item per row, full width), each row a heavy dark bronze/blackened-iron plate with riveted ends and a thin warm ember-orange edge light (not cyan). Left: icon in a bronze socket. Middle: name + level, one-line description, current→next value. Under the text a thin SEGMENTED level gauge (tick marks like a forge temperature gauge) filled with molten orange-gold to show level/max. Right: compact chunky level-up button (bronze, ember highlight) with rune cost chip, vertically centered. Rows are compact so all 5 fit with space below.
